mil6.2.3:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, atthi arahato satisammoso ti.
mil6.2.3:1.2: Vigata-satisammosā kho mahārāja arahanto, na-tthi arahantānaṃ satisammoso ti. -
mil6.2.3:1.6: Kuṭikāre mahārāja, sañcaritte, vikāle kālasaññāya, pavārite appavāritasaññāya, anatiritte atirittasaññāyāti. -
mil6.2.3:2.2: ye āpattiṃ āpajjanti te dvīhi kāraṇehi āpajjanti, anādariyena vā ajānanena vā ti.
mil6.2.3:2.3: Api nu kho bhante arahato anādariyaṃ hoti, yaṃ arahā āpattiṃ āpajjatīti. -
mil6.2.3:3.1: Yadi bhante Nāgasena arahā āpattiṃ āpajjati na-tthi ca arahato anādariyaṃ, tena hi atthi arahato satisammoso ti. -
mil6.2.3:3.2: Na-tthi mahārāja arahato satisammoso, āpattiñ-ca arahā āpajjatīti. -
mil6.2.3:4.1: Tena hi bhante kārāṇena maṃ saññāpehi, kiṃ tattha kāraṇan-ti.
mil6.2.3:4.6: yaṃ loke atthi samaṇānaṃ ananucchavikaṃ ananulomikaṃ, gihīnaṃ anavajjaṃ,
mil6.2.3:4.7: tattha Bhagavā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyaṃ:
mil6.2.3:4.8: vikālabhojanaṃ mahārāja lokassa anavajjaṃ, taṃ Jinasāsane vajjaṃ;
mil6.2.3:4.9: bhūtagāmavikopanaṃ mahārāja lokassa anavajjaṃ, taṃ Jinasāsane vajjaṃ;
mil6.2.3:4.10: udake hassadhammaṃ mahārāja lokassa anavajjaṃ, taṃ Jinasāsane vajjaṃ;
mil6.2.3:4.11: iti evarūpāni evarūpāni mahārāja Jinasāsane vajjāni; idaṃ vuccati paṇṇattivajjaṃ. Yaṃ kilesaṃ
mil6.2.3:5.1: yaṃ kilesaṃ paṇṇattivajjaṃ taṃ ajānanto āpajjeyya.
mil6.2.3:5.2: Avisayo mahārāja ekaccassa arahato sabbaṃ jānituṃ, na hi tassa balaṃ atthi sabbaṃ jānituṃ.
mil6.2.3:5.3: Anaññātaṃ mahārāja arahato itthipurisānaṃ nāmam-pi gottam-pi, maggo pi tassa mahiyā anaññāto;
mil6.2.3:5.4: vimuttiṃ yeva mahārāja ekacco arahā jāneyya,
mil6.2.3:5.6: Sabbaññū mahārāja Tathāgato va sabbaṃ jānātīti. -
mil6.2.3:5.7: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
